title: test comment wrong: closed() arm not tested
description: The test comment at line 1659 says the test exercises 'the live_tx.closed() arm of the select\!' — but the actual exit path is live_tx.is_closed() in the empty-batch branch (line 379). The task receives a Chat broadcast, filters it out (ChatContact filter), finds batch empty, then calls is_closed() which returns true and breaks. The select\! closed() arm (line 334) is never reached because a broadcast always wakes the task first. The comment is misleading: a reader maintaining the code will believe the select\! arm has test coverage when it does not.
